datasetDescription: Deterministic synthetic IIS-like request sequences for regression and comparative evaluation. All domains use .invalid and all addresses are documentation-only ranges.
labelQuality: All records are synthetic; no customer, production, or personally identifying data is included.
No sanitized production corpus was supplied; the versioned fixture format can also replay sanitized IIS event rows when such data is approved and available.
Labels are expected event-level analyst judgments for these constructed scenarios, not verified incident ground truth.

Authentication identity, account outcome, and request headers other than the captured UserAgent field are unavailable to the detector; credential-stuffing labels are intentionally limited to repeated 401 responses from one source.
Slow, distributed, and rotating-source scenarios are sequence-level hostile hypotheses; individual requests can be indistinguishable from legitimate traffic.
Each scenario has a fresh detector and in-memory event history; sequence behavior is replayed within each scenario, without history leaking across scenarios.
The dataset is deliberately small and scenario-balanced rather than prevalence-representative, so aggregate metrics must not be interpreted as expected production accuracy.
